phase: Phase S1: Adopt the OpenRouter SDK
summary: Two real-SDK tests fail. HTTP errors expose an echoed API key, and BM2 lets an SDK constructor error escape. The role gate fails on exactly these new test keys.
blocking_findings: ADV-1 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: providers.ts:35 copies an upstream message that contains the API key into the thrown Error. The real-SDK test providers.adversarial.test.ts:174 fails its key exclusion assertion. Both chatbot routes log provider errors. Rationale: spec.md:284 forbids API keys in logs. This test proves the failure behind review-b F2. Green must remove the key from thrown errors without changing numeric retry classification.

ADV-2 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: BM2 route.ts:181 resolves the SDK provider outside the try block. A malformed OPENROUTER_API_BASE makes POST reject with TypeError: Invalid URL. route.adversarial.test.ts:81 proves the fixed 502 response never runs. Rationale: S1 must preserve route error behavior. This test proves the regression behind review-b F3. Green must contain constructor errors in the route error handler.
